s.d: κλάσις, -εως, ἡ (κλάω), a breaking: [[luke 24 35|Luk.24:35]], [[acts 2 42|Act.2:42]].† (AS)

κλάσμα, -τος, τό (κλάω), [in LXX for פַּת, פֶּלַח ;] a broken piece, fragment: [[matthew 14 20|Mat.14:20 15:37]], [[mark 6 43|Mrk.6:43 8:8, 19-20]], [[luke 9 17|Luk.9:17]], [[john 6 12|Jhn.6:12-13]] † (AS)
Καῦδα (TR, mg., Κλαῦδα; Rec. Κλαύδή), ἡ, Cauda, Clauda, an island near Crete: [[acts 27 16|Act.27:16.]]† (AS)
Κλαυδία, -ας, ἡ Claudia: [[2-timothy 4 21|2Ti.4:21.]]† (AS)
Κλαύδιος, -ου, ὁ Claudius; 1. the Emperor: [[acts 11 28|Act.11:28 18:2]]. 2. A military tribune, C. Lysias: [[acts 23 26|Act.23:26.]]† (AS)
Κλαύδιος, -ου, ὁ Claudius; 1. the Emperor: [[acts 11 28|Act.11:28 18:2]]. 2. A military tribune, C. Lysias: [[acts 23 26|Act.23:26.]]† (AS)

κλαυθμός, -οῦ, ὁ (κλαίω), [in LXX chiefly for בְּכִי ;] crying, weeping, [[acts 20 37|Act.20:37;]] κ. καὶ ὀδυρμός, [[matthew 2 18|Mat.2:18]] (LXX); ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ βρυγμός, [[matthew 8 12|Mat.8:12 13:42, 50 22:13 24:51 25:30]], [[luke 13 28|Luk.13:28]].† (AS)

κλάω [in LXX: [[jeremiah 16 7|Jer.16:7]] (פַּרְנַךְ), al. ;] to break, break in pieces: of bread, [[matthew 14 19|Mat.14:19 15:36 26:26]], [[mark 8 6|Mrk.8:6 14:22]], [[luke 22 19|Luk.22:19 24:30]], [[acts 2 46|Act.2:46 20:7, 11 27:35]], [[1-corinthians 10 16|1Co.10:16 11:24]]; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), [[mark 8 19|Mrk.8:19]] (cf. ἐκ-, κατα-κλάω).† (AS)

κλείς, -δός Att.. accusative, κλεῖν, later -εῖδα, pl., κλεῖδες, -ας, contr., -εῖς, ἡ, [in LXX for מַפְתֵּחַ, [[isaiah 22 22|Isa.22:22]], al. ;] a key. Fig., τ. βασιλείας τ. οὐρανῶν, [[matthew 16 19|Mat.16:19;]] τ. γνώσεως, [[luke 11 52|Luk.11:52;]] of David (cf. LXX, l.with), [[revelation 3 7|Rev.3:7;]] τ. θανάτου κ. τ. ᾅδου, [[revelation 1 18|Rev.1:18;]] τ. ἀβύσσαυ, [[revelation 20 1|Rev.20:1;]] τ. φρέατος τῆς ἀ., [[revelation 9 1|Rev.9:1.]]† (AS)

κλείω [in LXX chiefly for סָגַר ;] to shut: θύραν, [[matthew 6 6|Mat.6:6;]] τ. ἄβυσσον, [[revelation 20 3|Rev.20:3;]] pass., θύρα, [[matthew 25 10|Mat.25:10]], [[luke 11 7|Luk.11:7]] (pl.), [[john 20 19|Jhn.20:19, 26]], [[acts 21 30|Act.21:30]]; δεσμωτήριον, [[acts 5 23|Act.5:23;]] πυλῶνες, [[revelation 21 25|Rev.21:25.]] Metaphorical, τ. οὐρανόν, [[luke 4 25|Luk.4:25]], [[romans 11 6|Rom.11:6]]; τ. σπλάγχνα, [[1-john 3 17|1Jn.3:17;]] τ. βασιλείαν, [[matthew 23 14|Mat.23:14;]] id. absol., [[revelation 3 7|Rev.3:7;]] τ. θύραν, [[revelation 3 8|Rev.3:8.]] (cf. ἀπο-, ἐκ-, κατα-, συν-κλείω.) † (AS)

κλέμμα, -τος, τό (κλέπτω), [in LXX: [[genesis 31 39|Gen.31:39]], [[exodus 22 3|Exo.22:3-4]] (2-3) (גָּנַב, גְּנֵבָה)* ;] 1. a thing stolen (Arist., LXX) 2. = κλοπή, theft (Plato, al.): pl., [[revelation 9 21|Rev.9:21.]]† (AS)
Κλεόπας, -α (see B1., § 7, 2), ὁ Cleopas: [[luke 24 18|Luk.24:18.]]† (AS)
κλέος, -ους, τό [in LXX: [[job 28 22|Job.28:22]] (שֵׁמַע) [[job 30 8|Job.30:8]] * ;] 1. a rumour, report. 2. good report, fame, glory: [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20.]]† (AS)

κλέπτης, -ου, ὁ [in LXX for גַּנָּב ;] a thief: [[matthew 6 19|Mat.6:19-20 24:43]], [[luke 12 33|Luk.12:33, 39]], [[john 10 1|Jhn.10:1, 10 12:6]], [[1-corinthians 6 10|1Co.6:10]], [[1-peter 4 15|1Pe.4:15]]. Fig., ὡς κ. ἐν νυκτί, [[1-thessalonians 5 2|1Th.5:2 5:4]] (κλέπτας, WH, txt., R, mg.; see Lft., Notes, 73; but cf. also M, Th., l.with), [[2-peter 3 10|2Pe.3:10]], [[revelation 3 3|Rev.3:3 16:15]]. Metaphorical, of false teachers, [[john 10 8|Jhn.10:8.]]† SYN.: λῃστής, a robber, a brigand who plunders, openly, with violence; κ. is a thief who steals in secret, by fraud and cunning (Tr., Syn., § xliv) (AS)

κλέπτω [in LXX for גָּנַב ;] to steal: absol., [[matthew 6 19|Mat.6:19-20 19:18]], [[mark 10 19|Mrk.10:19]], [[luke 18 20|Luk.18:20]], [[john 10 10|Jhn.10:10]], [[romans 2 21|Rom.2:21 13:9]], [[ephesians 4 28|Eph.4:28]]; with accusative, [[matthew 27 64|Mat.27:64 28:13]].† (AS)
κλῆμα, -τος, τό (κλάω), [in LXX chiefly for זְמוֹרָה, דָּלִיָּה, [[ezekiel 15 2|Eze.15:2 17:6-7]], al. ;] a vine-twig, vine-branch: [[john 15 2|Jhn.15:2, 4-6]].† (AS)
Κλήμης, -εντος, ὁ Clement: [[philippians 4 3|Php.4:3.]]† (AS)

κληρονομέω, -ῶ (κληρονόμος) [in LXX chiefly for יָרַשׁ, also for נָחַל, etc. ;] 1. to receive by lot. 2. to inherit (in cl., usually with genitive of thing(s)): absol., [[galatians 4 30|Gal.4:30]] (LXX); in general, to possess oneself of, receive as one's own, obtain (as [[deuteronomy 4 5|Deu.4:5]], al., cf. [[psalms 25 3|Psa.25:3]], [[isaiah 61 7|Isa.61:7]]): with accusative of thing(s) (as generally in late Gk., see M, Pr., 65), of the Messianic Kingdom (cf. [[psalms 37 11|Psa.37:11]], Sir.4:13 37:26, and see Dalman, Words, 125 ff.) and its bless­ings and privileges, τ. γῆν, [[matthew 5 5|Mat.5:5]] (cf. LXX); τ. βασιλείαν, β. θεοῦ, [[matthew 25 34|Mat.25:34]], [[1-corinthians 6 9|1Co.6:9-10 15:50]], [[galatians 5 21|Gal.5:21]]; ζωὴν αἰώνιον, [[matthew 19 29|Mat.19:29]], [[mark 10 17|Mrk.10:17]], [[luke 10 25|Luk.10:25 18:18]]; σωτηρίαν, [[hebrews 1 14|Heb.1:14;]] τ. ἐπαγγελίας, [[hebrews 6 12|Heb.6:12;]] ἀφθαρσίαν, [[1-corinthians 15 50|1Co.15:50;]] ὄνομα, [[hebrews 1 4|Heb.1:4;]] τ. εὐλογίαν, [[hebrews 12 17|Heb.12:17]], [[1-peter 3 9|1Pe.3:9]]; ταῦτα, [[revelation 21 7|Rev.21:7]] (cf. κατα-κληρονομέω).† (AS)

κληρονομία, -ας, ἡ (κληρονόμος) [in LXX chiefly for נַחֲלָה, also for יְרֻשָּׁה, etc. ;] prop., an inherited property, an inheritance: [[matthew 21 38|Mat.21:38]], [[mark 12 7|Mrk.12:7]], [[luke 12 13|Luk.12:13 20:14]]; in general, a possession, inheritance: [[acts 7 5|Act.7:5]], [[hebrews 11 8|Heb.11:8]]; of the Messianic Kingdom and its blessings, [[acts 20 32|Act.20:32]], [[galatians 3 18|Gal.3:18]], [[colossians 3 24|Col.3:24]], [[ephesians 1 14|Eph.1:14, 18 5:5]], [[hebrews 9 15|Heb.9:15]], [[1-peter 1 4|1Pe.1:4]].† (AS)

κληρο-νόμος, -ου, ὁ (κλῆρος, νέμομαι, to possess) [in LXX: [[judges 18 7|Jdg.18:7]], [[2-samuel 14 7|2Ki.14:7]], [[micah 1 15|Mic.1:15]], [[jeremiah 8 10|Jer.8:10]] (יָרַשׁ), Sir.23:22 * ;] 1. (as in cl.) an heir: [[matthew 21 38|Mat.21:38]], [[mark 12 7|Mrk.12:7]], [[luke 20 14|Luk.20:14]], [[galatians 4 1|Gal.4:1]]; of those who as sons of God inherit the privileges of the Messianic Kingdom; of Christ himself, [[hebrews 1 2|Heb.1:2;]] of Abraham, [[romans 4 13|Rom.4:13-14;]] of Christians, [[romans 8 17|Rom.8:17]], [[galatians 3 29|Gal.3:29]], [[titus 3 7|Tit.3:7]], [[james 2 5|Jas.2:5]]. 2. (As in LXX: Jg, Mi, Je, ll. with) a possessor: [[hebrews 6 17|Heb.6:17 11:7]] (Cremer, 359 f.).† (AS)

κλῆρος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for נַחֲלָה גּוֹרָל ;] a lot; (a) that which is cast or drawn: [[matthew 27 35|Mat.27:35]], [[mark 15 24|Mrk.15:24]], [[luke 23 34|Luk.23:34]], [[john 19 24|Jhn.19:24]]" (LXX), [[acts 1 26|Act.1:26;]] (b) that which is obtained by casting: [[acts 1 17|Act.1:17 8:21]]; of a part in the Kingdom of God (cf. Wis 55), [[acts 26 18|Act.26:18]], [[colossians 1 12|Col.1:12]]; pl. of the "cure" of a presbyter, [[1-peter 5 3|1Pe.5:3]] (see ICC, in l).† (AS)

κληρόω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[1-samuel 14 41|1Ki.14:41]] (לָכַד ni.), [[esther 4 11|Est.4:11]] A (קָרָא ni.), [[isaiah 17 11|Isa.17:11]] * ;] 1. to cast lots. 2. to choose by lot. 3. to assign by lot, assign a portion: pass., ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν, [[ephesians 1 11|Eph.1:11]] (on the various interpretations, see ICC; AR; Ellic., in l).† (AS)

κλῆσις, -εως, ἡ (καλέω) [in LXX: [[jeremiah 31 6|Jer.31:6]] (קָרָא), Jdth.12:10 A, 3Ma.5:14 * ;] a calling, call; in NT, always of the Divine call to salvation: [[romans 11 29|Rom.11:29]], [[1-corinthians 1 26|1Co.1:26 7:20]], [[ephesians 1 18|Eph.1:18 4:1, 4]], [[philippians 3 14|Php.3:14]], [[2-thessalonians 1 11|2Th.1:11]], [[2-timothy 1 9|2Ti.1:9]], [[hebrews 3 1|Heb.3:1]], [[2-peter 1 10|2Pe.1:10]] (Cremer, 332).† (AS)

κλητός, -ή, -όν (καλέω), [in LXX for קָרָא, מִקְרָא, [[exodus 12 16|Exo.12:16]], al. ;] called, invited (as to a banquet, Æsch., [[1-samuel 1 41|1Sa 1:41]], 3Ma.5:14); in NT, always of the Divine call; (a) to some office: κ. ἀπόστολος, [[romans 1 1|Rom.1:1]], [[1-corinthians 1 1|1Co.1:1]]; (b) to salvation: [[romans 8 28|Rom.8:28]], [[1-corinthians 1 24|1Co.1:24]], Ju 1; κ. καὶ ἐκλεκτοὶ κ. πιστοί, [[revelation 17 14|Rev.17:14;]] in gosp. (not in pl., see: καλέω) disting. fr.ἐκλεκτός, [[matthew 20 16|Mat.20:16]] (WH, txt., R, omit), [[matthew 22 14|Mat.22:14;]] κ. Ἰησοῦ Χρ., [[romans 1 6|Rom.1:6;]] κ. ἅγιοι, saints by calling, [[romans 1 7|Rom.1:7]], [[1-corinthians 1 2|1Co.1:2]].† (AS)

κλίβανος, -ον, ό (Att.., κρίβ-, but κλ- in Ion., Hdt., ii, 92), [in LXX for תַּנּוּר, [[genesis 15 17|Gen.15:17]], [[hosea 7 4|Hos.7:4]], 6 al. ;] 1. in cl., a clibanus, cribanus, an earthen vessel for baking bread. 2. In LXX and NT, a furnace (cf. MM, Exp., xv), an oven: [[matthew 6 30|Mat.6:30]], [[luke 12 28|Luk.12:28]].† (AS)

κλίμα, -τος, τό (κλίνω) [in LXX: [[judges 20 2|Jdg.20:2]] A (פִּנָּה)* ;] 1. an inclination, slope, esp. the slope from the equator to the pole (Arist). 2. a region (Polyb., al.): pl., [[romans 15 23|Rom.15:23]], [[2-corinthians 11 10|2Co.11:10]], [[galatians 1 21|Gal.1:21]].† (AS)

κλίνη, -ης, ἡ (κλίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִטָּה ;] a bed, couch: [[matthew 9 2|Mat.9:2]], 6, [[mark 4 21|Mrk.4:21 7:4, 30]], [[luke 5 18|Luk.5:18 8:16 17:34]], [[revelation 2 22|Rev.2:22]] (cf. MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)
κλινίδιον, -ου, τό dimin. of κλίνη, a conch: [[luke 5 19|Luk.5:19, 24]] (cf. κλενάριον).† (AS)

κλίνω [in LXX chiefly for נָטָה ;] 1. to make to bend, to bow: τ. κεφαλήν (of one dying), [[john 19 30|Jhn.19:30;]] τ. πρόσωτον (of terrified persons), [[luke 24 5|Luk.24:5.]] 2. to make to lean, to rest: τ. κεφαλήν (in sleep), [[matthew 8 20|Mat.8:20]], [[luke 9 58|Luk.9:58]]. 3. As in Hom., of soldiers, to turn (to flight), παρεμβολάς, [[hebrews 11 34|Heb.11:34.]] 4. In late Gk. (as mid, in cl.), to decline: intrans., ἡ ἡμέρα, [[luke 9 12|Luk.9:12 24:29]].† (AS)

κλισία, -ας, ή (κλίνω), [in LXX: 3Ma.6:31 A* ;] 1. a place for reclining; hence, (a) a hut; (b) an easy chair; (with) a couch. 2. a company reclining: pl., [[luke 9 14|Luk.9:14]] (cf. FlJ, Ant., xii, 2, 12) (AS)
κλοπή, -ῆν, ἡ (κλέπτω), [in LXX for גָּנַב ;] theft: pl., [[matthew 15 19|Mat.15:19]], [[mark 7 22|Mrk.7:22]].† (AS)

κλύδων, -ωνος, ὁ (κλύζω, of the sea, to wash over), [in LXX: [[jonah 1 4|Jon.1.4;]] [[jonah 1 12|Jon.1.12]] (סַעַר), al. ;] a billow, surge: [[luke 8 24|Luk.8:24]], [[james 1 6|Jas.1:6]].† SYN.: κῦμα, a wave (AS)
κλυδωνίζομαι (κλύδων), [in LXX: [[isaiah 57 20|Isa.57:20]] (גָּרַשׁ)* ;] to be tossed by waves; metaphorically, to be tossed like waves (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 11, 3): [[ephesians 4 14|Eph.4:14.]]† (AS)
Κλωπᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram.; on the original, see Lft., Gal., 267 f.), Clopas: [[john 19 25|Jhn.19:25.]]† (AS)
κνήθω (late form of κνάω), 1. to scratch. 2. to tickle; pass., to itch: [[2-timothy 4 3|2Ti.4:3.]]† (AS)
Κνίδος, -ου, ἡ Cnidus, a city (and peninsula) on S.W. coast of Asia Minor: [[acts 27 7|Act.27:7.]]† (AS)
κοδράντης, -ου, ὁ (Lat. quadrans, the fourth part of an as), a quadrans (AV, farthing): [[matthew 5 26|Mat.5:26]], [[mark 12 42|Mrk.12:42]].† (AS)

κοιλία, -ας, ἡ (κοῖλος, hollow), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּטֶן, מֵעֶה, קֶרֶב, [[deuteronomy 7 13|Deu.7:13]], [[2-samuel 7 12|2Ki.7:12]], [[genesis 41 21|Gen.41:21]], al.; also ([[job 3 11|Job.3:11 10:18 31:15 38:8]]) for רֶחֶם ;] 1. the belly (stomach or intestines or both): [[matthew 12 40|Mat.12:40 15:17]], [[mark 7 19|Mrk.7:19]], [[luke 15 16|Luk.15:16]], [[romans 16 18|Rom.16:18]], [[1-corinthians 6 13|1Co.6:13]], [[philippians 3 19|Php.3:19]], [[revelation 10 9|Rev.10:9-10]]. 2. (As often in LXX) the womb: [[luke 1 41|Luk.1:41-42, 44 2:21 11:27 23:29]], [[john 3 4|Jhn.3:4]]; ἐκ κ. μητρός (cf. [[psalms 22 11|Psa.22:11]], [[job 1 21|Job.1:21]], al.), [[matthew 19 12|Mat.19:12]], [[luke 1 15|Luk.1:15]], [[acts 3 2|Act.3:2 14:8]], [[galatians 1 15|Gal.1:15]]. 3. Metaphorical (as Heb. בֶּטֶן, cf. [[job 15 35|Job.15:35]], [[proverbs 20 27|Pro.20:27]], Sir.19:12), of the heart: [[john 7 38|Jhn.7:38.]]† (AS)

κοιμάω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַב ;] to lull to sleep, put to sleep. Mid and pass., to fall asleep (M, Pr., 162; M, Th., 1, 4, 13): [[matthew 28 13|Mat.28:13]], [[luke 22 45|Luk.22:45]], [[john 11 12|Jhn.11:12]], [[acts 12 6|Act.12:6]]. Metaph, of death: [[matthew 27 52|Mat.27:52]], [[john 11 11|Jhn.11:11]] [[acts 7 60|Act.7:60 13:36]], [[1-corinthians 7 39|1Co.7:39 11:30 15:6 15:18 15:20 15:51]], [[1-thessalonians 4 13|1Th.4:13-15]], [[2-peter 3 4|2Pe.3:4]] (cf. [[isaiah 14 8|Isa.14:8 43:17]], 2Ma.12:45).† SYN.: καθεύδω (AS)
κοίμησις, -εως, ἡ [in LXX: Sir.46:19 48:13 * ;] a reclining, resting: [[john 11 13|Jhn.11:13.]]† (AS)

κοινός, -ή, -όν [in LXX: [[proverbs 1 14|Pro.1:14]] (אֶחָד) [[proverbs 21 9|Pro.21:9 25:24]] (חֶבֶר), Wis.7:3, al. ;] 1. common (general; = Lat. communis): [[acts 2 44|Act.2:44 4:32]]; κ. πίστις, [[titus 1 4|Tit.1:4;]] σωτηρία, Ju 3 2. common (ordinary; = vulgaris); hence in LXX (1Ma.1:47, al.) and NT, unhallowed, unclean (cl., βέβηλος, which see): [[mark 7 2|Mrk.7:2]], 5, [[acts 10 14|Act.10:14, 28 11:8]], [[romans 14 14|Rom.14:14]], [[hebrews 10 29|Heb.10:29]], [[revelation 21 27|Rev.21:27]].† (AS)

κοινός, -ή, -όν [in LXX: [[proverbs 1 14|Pro.1:14]] (אֶחָד) [[proverbs 21 9|Pro.21:9 25:24]] (חֶבֶר), Wis.7:3, al. ;] 1. common (general; = Lat. communis): [[acts 2 44|Act.2:44 4:32]]; κ. πίστις, [[titus 1 4|Tit.1:4;]] σωτηρία, Ju 3 2. common (ordinary; = vulgaris); hence in LXX (1Ma.1:47, al.) and NT, unhallowed, unclean (cl., βέβηλος, which see): [[mark 7 2|Mrk.7:2]], 5, [[acts 10 14|Act.10:14, 28 11:8]], [[romans 14 14|Rom.14:14]], [[hebrews 10 29|Heb.10:29]], [[revelation 21 27|Rev.21:27]].† (AS)

κοινόω, -ῶ [in LXX: 4Ma.7:6 א R* ;] 1. in cl., to make common. 2. In LXX, l.with, and NT (as κοινός, 2), to make ceremonially unclean, to profane (= cl., βεληλόω): [[matthew 15 11|Mat.15:11, 18 15:20]], [[mark 7 15|Mrk.7:15, 18 7:20, 23]], [[acts 21 28|Act.21:28]]; pass., [[hebrews 9 13|Heb.9:13.]] 3. to count unclean (cf. δικαιόω): [[acts 10 15|Act.10:15 11:9]].† SYN.: βεβηλόω. Thayer (see word κ.) mentions that Winer Notes the accuracy whereby the Jews are said to use κ. in addressing Jews, [[acts 21 28|Act.21:28]], and β. when speaking to Felix, 24:6 (Cremer, 362) (AS)

κοινωνέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 20 35|2Ch.20:35]], [[job 34 8|Job.34:8]], [[ecclesiastes 9 4|Ecc.9:4]] (חָבַר), [[proverbs 1 11|Pro.1:11]], Wis.6:23, Sir.13:1, al. ;] to have a share of, go shares in (something) with (some one), take part in: with genitive of thing(s) (as usually in cl., so Pr, l.with), [[hebrews 2 14|Heb.2:14;]] with dative of thing(s), [[romans 12 13|Rom.12:13 15:27]], [[1-timothy 5 22|1Ti.5:22]], [[1-peter 4 13|1Pe.4:13]], 2Jn.11; with dative of person(s), before εἰς, [[philippians 4 15|Php.4:15;]] ἐν, [[galatians 6 6|Gal.6:6]] (cf. συν-κοινωνέω).† (AS)

κοινωνία, -ας, ἡ (κοινωνός), [in LXX: [[leviticus 6 2|Lev.6:2]] (יָד תְּשׂוּמֶת), Wis.8:18, 3Ma.4:6 * ;] 1. fellowship, communion: [[acts 2 42|Act.2:42]], [[2-corinthians 6 14|2Co.6:14]], [[philippians 1 5|Php.1:5]]; τ. υἱοῦ, [[1-corinthians 1 9|1Co.1:9;]] τ. αἵματος, σώματος Χρ., [[1-corinthians 10 10|1Co.10:10]] : παθημάτων αὐτσῦ, [[philippians 3 10|Php.3:10;]] τ. πνεύματος, [[2-corinthians 13 13|2Co.13:13]], [[philippians 2 1|Php.2:1]]; δεξιὰς κοινωνίας, [[galatians 2 9|Gal.2:9;]] τ. πίστεώς σου, Phm 6; before μετὰ: τ. πατρός, [[1-john 1 3|1Jn.1:3]] [[john 1 6|Jn 1:6]]; ἡμῶν, ἀλλήλων, [[1-john 1 3|1Jn.1:3]] [[john 1 7|Jn 1:7]]. 2. contribution (as outcome of fellowship): [[romans 15 26|Rom.15:26]], [[2-corinthians 8 4|2Co.8:4 9:13]], [[hebrews 13 6|Heb.13:6]] (cf. Art. Communion, DB, i, 460 ff.; MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)
κοινωνικός, -ή, -όν (κοινωνία), 1. sociable. 2. ready to com­municate or impart (R, mg., ready to sympathize, see Field, Notes, 213 f.): [[1-timothy 6 18|1Ti.6:18.]]† (AS)

κοινωνός, -ή, -όν (κοινός), [in LXX: [[proverbs 28 24|Pro.28:24]], [[isaiah 1 23|Isa.1:23]] (חָבֵר), [[malachi 2 14|Mal.2:14]] (חֲבֶרֶת), [[esther 8 13|Est.8:13]], al. ;] 1. as adj., = κοινός. 2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ κ., (a) a partner, associate, companion: [[2-corinthians 8 23|2Co.8:23]], Phm 17; with dative of person(s), [[luke 5 10|Luk.5:10;]] with genitive of person(s), [[hebrews 10 33|Heb.10:33;]] id. before ἐν, [[matthew 23 30|Mat.23:30;]] (b) a partaker, sharer: with genitive of thing(s), [[1-corinthians 10 18|1Co.10:18 10:20]], [[2-corinthians 1 7|2Co.1:7]], [[1-peter 5 1|1Pe.5:1]], [[2-peter 1 4|2Pe.1:4]] (see Deiss., BS, 368 n2).† (AS)

κοίτη, -ης, ἡ (in Hom., κοῖτος) [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁכָּב, also for שְׁכָבָה, etc. ;] a bed: [[luke 11 7|Luk.11:7;]] esp. the marriage-bed: κ. ἀμίαντος, [[hebrews 13 4|Heb.13:4;]] κ. ἔχειν, of a woman conceiving, [[romans 9 10|Rom.9:10]] (cf. peculiar phrases in LXX, [[leviticus 15 18|Lev.15:18]], al.); of illicit intercourse, pl., [[romans 13 13|Rom.13:13.]]† (AS)

κοιτών, -ῶνος, ὁ (κοίτη = Att.., δωμότιον, see Kennedy, Sources, 40), [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר, [[2-kings 4 7|2Ki.4:7]], [[joel 2 16|Jol.2:16;]] I [[esther 3 3|Est.3:3]], al. ;] a bed-chamber; ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ κ., a chamberlain: [[acts 12 20|Act.12:20.]]† (AS)

κόκκινος, -η, -ον (κόκκος, as used of the "berry" of the ilex coccifera, see DB, iv, 416), [in LXX for תּוֹלָע, תּוֹלָע, שָׁנִי, [[exodus 25 4|Exo.25:4]], [[genesis 38 23|Gen.38:23]], [[isaiah 1 18|Isa.1:18]], al. ;] scarlet: [[matthew 27 28|Mat.27:28]], [[hebrews 9 19|Heb.9:19]], [[revelation 17 3|Rev.17:3]]; neut., without substantive, of clothing, [[revelation 17 4|Rev.17:4 18:12, 16]],† (AS)

κόκκος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: [[lamentations 4 5|La 4:5]] B א R (תּוֹלָע), Sir.45:11 * ;] a grain: [[matthew 13 31|Mat.13:31 17:20]], [[mark 4 31|Mrk.4:31]], [[luke 13 19|Luk.13:19 17:6]], [[john 12 24|Jhn.12:24]], [[1-corinthians 15 37|1Co.15:37]].† (AS)

κολάζω (κόλος, docked), [in LXX: [[daniel 6 12|Dan.6:12]] (13) (no Heb.), I [[esther 8 24|Est.8:24]], Wis.3:4 (and freq.), 1Ma.7:7, al. ;] 1. to curtail, dock, prune. 2. to check, restrain. 3. to chastise, correct, punish: pass., [[2-peter 2 9|2Pe.2:9;]] mid., cause to be punished (3Ma.7:3): [[acts 4 21|Act.4:21]].† (AS)
κολακία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ (κολακεύω, to flatter), flattery: [[1-thessalonians 2 5|1Th.2:5]] (see Lft., Notes, 23).† (AS)

κόλασις, -εως, ἡ (κολάζω), [in LXX: [[ezekiel 14 3|Eze.14:3-7 18:30 44:12]], (מִכְשׁוֹל) [[ezekiel 43 11|Eze.43:11]], λαμβάνειν τὴν κ. (כָּלַם ni.); Wis.11:13 16:2, 24 19:4, [[jeremiah 18 20|Jer.18:20, 2-4]] Mac.5 * ;] correction, penalty, punishment: [[matthew 25 46|Mat.25:46]], [[1-john 4 18|1Jn.4:18]].† SYN.: τιμωρία, requital. Arist. distinguishes between κ . as that which, being disciplinary, has reference to the sufferer, and τ. as that which, being penal, has reference to the satisfaction of him who inflicts (see Thayer, see word κ., and cf. Tr., Syn., § vii). But in late Gk. especially, the distinction is not always maintained (see reff. in Thayer) (AS)

κολαφίζω (κόλαφος = Att.., κόνδυλοι, the knuckles, the closed fist) to strike with the fist, to buffet: [[matthew 26 67|Mat.26:67]], [[mark 14 65|Mrk.14:65]], [[2-corinthians 12 7|2Co.12:7]]; pass., [[1-corinthians 4 11|1Co.4:11]], [[1-peter 2 20|1Pe.2:20]].† (AS)

κολλάω, -ῶ (κόλλα, glue), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;] 1. to glue or cement together. 2. Generally, to unite, to join firmly. Pass., to cleave to, join (oneself to): with dative of person(s), [[matthew 19 5|Mat.19:5]](LXX), [[luke 10 11|Luk.10:11 15:15]], [[acts 5 13|Act.5:13]] (but see Field, Notes, 118) [[acts 9 26|Act.9:26 10:28]] (see Field, l.with) [[acts 17 34|Act.17:34;]] τ. πόρνῃ, [[1-corinthians 6 16|1Co.6:16;]] τ. Κυρίῳ, [[1-corinthians 6 17|1Co.6:17;]] with dative of thing(s), ἅρματι, [[acts 8 29|Act.8:29;]] τ. ἀγαθῴ, [[romans 12 9|Rom.12:9;]] of sins joining together, ἄχρι τ. οὐρανοῦ, [[revelation 18 5|Rev.18:5]], of dust, [[luke 10 11|Luk.10:11]] (cf. τροσ-κολλάω).† (AS)

κολλούριον (TTr., κολλύ-, the more usual form), -ου, τό (dimin. of κολλύρα = κόλλιξ, a coarse bread roll), [in LXX: [[1-kings 12 24|3Ki.12:24]] hil B* ;] 1. a small bread roll (LXX, ll. with). 2. (Usually in pl., LS, see word) an eye salve shaped like a roll: [[revelation 3 18|Rev.3:18.]]† (AS)
κολλυβιστής, -οῦ, ὁ (κόλλυβος, a small coin, a rate of exchange), a money-changer: [[matthew 21 12|Mat.21:12]], [[mark 11 15|Mrk.11:15]], [[john 2 15|Jhn.2:15]] (of. κερματιοτής).† (AS)

κολοβόω, -ῶ (κολοβός, docked), [in LXX: [[2-samuel 4 12|2Ki.4:12]] (קָצַץ pi.) * ;] to cut off, amputate (LXX), hence, to curtail, shorten: [[matthew 24 22|Mat.24:22]], [[mark 13 20|Mrk.13:20]].† (AS)
Κολοσσαί (so in cl.; -ασσαί, Rec., LTr.), -ῶν, αἰ Colossæ, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia: [[colossians 1 2|Col.1:2.]]† (AS)
Κολοσσαί (so in cl.; -ασσαί, Rec., LTr.), -ῶν, αἰ Colossæ, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia: [[colossians 1 2|Col.1:2.]]† (AS)
Κολασσαεύς (Rec. Κολοσ-), -έως, ὁ a Colossian: pl., Col., tit. (and subscr., Rec., Tr.).† (AS)

κόλπος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for חֵיק ;] 1. prop., the bosom: [[john 13 23|Jhn.13:23;]] fig., of close association, ἐν (εἰς τὸν) τοῖς κ. Ἀβραάμ, [[luke 16 22|Luk.16:22-23]] (cf. 4Ma.13:16); ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κ. τ. πατρός, [[john 1 18|Jhn.1:18]] 2. The bosom or fold of a loose garment falling over a girdle, used as a pocket, hence figuratively, εἰς τὸν κ. [[isaiah 65 6|Isa.65:6]], [[jeremiah 32 18|Jer.32:18]] : [[luke 6 38|Luk.6:38]] 3. A bosom-like hollow, as a bay or gulf: [[acts 27 39|Act.27:39.]]† (AS)
κολυμβάω, -ῶ [in AI.: [[isaiah 25 11|Isa.25:11]] * ;] to dive, plunge into the sea: [[acts 27 43|Act.27:43]] (cf. ἐκ-κολνμβάω).† (AS)
κολυμβήθρα, -ας, ἡ (κολνμβάω), [in LXX for בְּרֵכָה, [[2-kings 18 27|4Ki.18:27]], al. ;] a swimming pool, pool: [[john 5 2|Jhn.5:2, 4 5:7 9:7]].† (AS)
κολωνία (Rec. -ώνια), -ας, ἡ (Lat. colonic), a colony: [[acts 16 12|Act.16:12]] (see Lft., Phi., 50 f.).† (AS)
κομάω, -ῶ (κόμη), to wear long hair: [[1-corinthians 11 14|1Co.11:14-15.]]† (AS)
κόμη, -ης, ἡ [in LXX: [[numbers 6 5|Num.6:5]], [[ezekiel 44 20|Eze.44:20]] (פֶּרַע), al. ;] the hair: [[1-corinthians 11 15|1Co.11:15.]]† (AS)

κομίζω [in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;] 1. to take care of. 2. to carry off safe. 3. to carry off as booty. 4. to bear or carry: [[luke 7 37|Luk.7:37.]] Mid., to bear for oneself, hence, (a) to receive: [[hebrews 10 36|Heb.10:36 11:13, 39]], [[1-peter 1 9|1Pe.1:9 5:4]], [[2-peter 2 13|2Pe.2:13]]; (b) to receive back, recover (in cl. so also act.): [[matthew 25 27|Mat.25:27]], [[hebrews 11 19|Heb.11:19]]; metaphorically, of requital, [[2-corinthians 5 10|2Co.5:10]], [[colossians 3 25|Col.3:25]]; παρὰ Κυρίου, [[ephesians 6 8|Eph.6:8]] (cf. ἐκ-, συν-κομίζω).† (AS)

κομψός, -ή, -όν (κομέω, to take care of), well-dressed, elegant, fine; compar. neut., κομψότερον ἔχειν (cf. κόμψως ἔχειν, Epict., and colloq. Eng., "to be doing finely"): [[john 4 52|Jhn.4:52.]]† (AS)

κονιάω, -ῶ (κονία, dust, lime), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 27 2|Deu.27:2]], 4 (שִׂיד), [[proverbs 21 9|Pro.21:9]] * ;] to plaster or whiten over: of tombs, [[matthew 23 27|Mat.23:27;]] figuratively, of a hypocrite, [[acts 23 3|Act.23:3.]]† (AS)

κονιορτός, -οῦ, ὁ (κόνις or κονία, dust, ὄρνυμι, to stir up), [in LXX for אָבָק, etc. ;] in cl., dust stirred up ([[exodus 9 9|Exo.9:9]], [[isaiah 5 24|Isa.5:24]]); in NT, simply dust: [[matthew 10 14|Mat.10:14]], [[luke 9 5|Luk.9:5 10:11]], [[acts 13 51|Act.13:51 22:23]].† (AS)

κοπάζω (κόπος), [in LXX: [[genesis 8 1|Gen.8:1]], [[esther 2 1|Est.2:1 7:10]] (שָׁכַךְ), [[ruth 1 18|Rut.1:18]], al. (חָדַל), חָדַל), [[jonah 1 11|Jon.1.11-12]] (שָׁתַק), al. ;] to grow weary; of the wind (Hdt., Jh., l.with), to abate, cease raging: [[matthew 14 32|Mat.14:32]], [[mark 4 39|Mrk.4:39 6:51]].† (AS)
κοπετός, -οῦ, ὁ (κόπτω, mid.), [in LXX chiefly for מִסְפֵּד ;] = cl. κομμός, a beating of the head and breast, lamentation: before ἐπί with dative of person(s), [[acts 8 2|Act.8:2.]]† (AS)

κοπή, -ῆς, ἡ (κόπτω), [in LXX: [[genesis 14 17|Gen.14:17]], [[joshua 10 20|Jos.10:20]] (נָכָה hi., מַכָּה), [[deuteronomy 28 25|Deu.28:25]] (נָגַף), Jdth.15:7 * ;] 1. in cl., a stroke, a pounding (as in a mortar). 2. In LXX, a smiting in battle: [[hebrews 7 1|Heb.7:1]] (LXX).† (AS)

κοπιάω, -ῶ (κόπος), [in LXX chiefly for יָגַע ;] 1. (as in cl.) to grow weary: [[matthew 11 28|Mat.11:28]], [[john 4 6|Jhn.4:6]], [[revelation 2 3|Rev.2:3]] (cf. [[isaiah 40 31|Isa.40:31]]). 2. Hence, in LXX and NT, to work with effort, to toil: absol., [[matthew 6 23|Mat.6:23]], [[luke 5 5|Luk.5:5 12:27]], [[john 4 38|Jhn.4:38]], [[acts 20 35|Act.20:35]], [[1-corinthians 4 12|1Co.4:12]], [[ephesians 4 28|Eph.4:28]], [[2-timothy 2 5|2Ti.2:5]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[john 4 38|Jhn.4:38;]] frequently in Paul. Epp., of ministerial labour: [[1-corinthians 15 10|1Co.15:10 16:16]]; before ἐν, [[romans 16 12|Rom.16:12]], [[1-thessalonians 5 12|1Th.5:12]] (see M, Th., in l), [[1-timothy 5 17|1Ti.5:17;]] εἰς, [[romans 16 6|Rom.16:6]], [[galatians 4 11|Gal.4:11]], [[philippians 2 16|Php.2:16]], [[colossians 1 29|Col.1:29]], [[1-timothy 4 10|1Ti.4:10]].† (AS)

κόπος, -ου, ὁ (κόπτω) [in LXX chiefly for עָמָל, also for אָוֶן, etc. ;] 1. a striking, beating (in [[jeremiah 45 3|Jer.45:3]] = κοπετός) 2. laborious toil, trouble: [[john 4 38|Jhn.4:38]], [[1-corinthians 3 8|1Co.3:8 15:58]], [[1-thessalonians 3 5|1Th.3:5]]; κ. τ. ἀγάπης, [[1-thessalonians 1 3|1Th.1:3;]] ἔργα καὶ κ., [[revelation 2 2|Rev.2:2;]] κ. καὶ μόχθος, [[2-corinthians 11 27|2Co.11:27]], [[1-thessalonians 2 9|1Th.2:9]], [[2-thessalonians 3 8|2Th.3:8]]; pl., ἐν κ., [[2-corinthians 6 5|2Co.6:5 10:15 11:23]]; ἐκ τ. κ., [[revelation 14 13|Rev.14:13;]] κόπονς (-ον) παρέχειν (in cl. more frequently π. πράγματα, πονον), with dative of person(s), [[matthew 26 10|Mat.26:10]], [[mark 14 6|Mrk.14:6]], [[luke 11 7|Luk.11:7 18:5]], [[galatians 6 17|Gal.6:17]].† SYN.: μόλθος, labour; πόνος (which see), toil, painful effort; in cl., "π. gives prominence to the effort (work as requiring force), κ. to the fatigue, μ. (chiefly poetic) to the hardship" (Thayer, see word κ.) (AS)

κοπρία, -ας, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for אַשְׁפֹּת ;] a dung hill ([[1-kings 2 8|1Ki.2:8]], [[psalms 113 7|Psa.113:7]] al.): [[luke 14 35|Luk.14:35]].† κόπριον, -ου, τό, [in LXX (pl.): [[jeremiah 25 33|Jer.25:33]] (דֹּמֶן), Sir.22:2, 1Ma.2:62 * ;] = κόπρος, dung: pl., [[luke 13 8|Luk.13:8]] (WH, mg., κόφινον κοπρίων).† (AS)

κόπτω [in LXX for כָּרַת, סָפַד, נָכָה hi., etc. ;] 1. to strike, smite. 2. to cut off: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, [[matthew 21 8|Mat.21:8;]] ἐκ, [[mark 11 8|Mrk.11:8.]] Mid., to beat one's breast with grief, to mourn, bewail: [[matthew 11 17|Mat.11:17 24:30]]; with accusative of person(s), [[luke 8 52|Luk.8:52 23:27]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[revelation 1 7|Rev.1:7 18:9]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐν-, κατα-, προ-, προσ-κόπτω).† SYN.: θρηνέω, q.v (AS)
κόραξ, -ακος, ὁ [in LXX for עֹרֵב ;] a raven: [[luke 12 24|Luk.12:24.]]† (AS)

κοράσιον, -ου, τό (dimin. of κόρη), [in LXX chiefly for נַעֲרָה, [[ruth 2 8|Rut.2:8]], al.; in [[joel 4 3|Joel 4:3]], [[zechariah 8 5|Zec.8:5]] for יַלְדָּה ;] a colloquial word which survives in MGr. (Kennedy, Sourcs, e154), girl, maiden: [[matthew 9 24|Mat.9:24-25 14:11]], [[mark 5 41|Mrk.5:41-42 6:22, 28]].† (AS)
κορβάν (Rec., T, -βᾶν), indecl. (Heb. קׇרְבָּן), an offering, a gift offered to God: [[mark 7 11|Mrk.7:11]] (cf. κορβανᾶς).† (AS)
Κορέ indecl. (in FlJ, -έου), ὁ (Heb. קֶרַח) Korah: Ju 11.† (AS)

κορέννυμι (κόρος, surfeit), [in Symmachus.: [[psalms 22 27|Psa.22:27]], Al, [[psalms 103 5|Psa.103:5]] * ;] to satisfy: pass., τροφῆς, [[acts 27 38|Act.27:38;]] metaphorically, of spiritual things, [[1-corinthians 4 8|1Co.4:8.]]† (AS)
κορίνθιος, -α, -ον Corinthian; as subst., ὁ Κ., a Corinthian: [[acts 18 8|Act.18:8 27:1-44]] (WH, txt., R, omit), [[2-corinthians 6 11|2Co.6:11;]] 1Co, 2Co, tit.† (AS)
Κόρινθος, -ου, ἡ Corinth: [[acts 18 1|Act.18:1, 27 19:1]], [[1-corinthians 1 2|1Co.1:2]], [[2-corinthians 1 1|2Co.1:1 1:23]], [[2-timothy 4 20|2Ti.4:20]].† (AS)
Κορνήλιος, -ου, ὁ (Lat.) Cornelius: [[acts 10 1|Act.10:1]] ff.† (AS)

κόρος, -ου, ὁ (Heb. כֹּר), [in LXX: [[leviticus 27 16|Lev.27:16]], [[numbers 11 32|Num.11:32]], [[ezekiel 45 13|Eze.45:13]] (חֹמֶר); more freq., [[2-chronicles 27 5|2Ch.27:5]], al.(כֹּר) ;] a cor, a Hebrew measure (AV, RV, measure): [[luke 16 7|Luk.16:7.]]† (AS)

κοσμέω, -ῶ (κόσμος), [in LXX for עָדָה, תָּקַן, etc. ;] 1. to order, arrange, prepare (in Hom. esp. of marshalling armies): [[matthew 25 7|Mat.25:7]] (cf. Sir.50:9, al.). 2. to adorn, furnish: οἶκον, pass., [[matthew 12 44|Mat.12:44]], [[luke 11 25|Luk.11:25]]; μνημεῖα, [[matthew 23 29|Mat.23:29;]] τὸ ἱερόν, pass., [[luke 21 5|Luk.21:5;]] θεμέλιοι, [[revelation 21 19|Rev.21:19;]] νύμφην, pass., [[revelation 21 2|Rev.21:2;]] ἐαυτάς, before ἐν, [[1-timothy 2 9|1Ti.2:9.]] Metaphorical, with accusative of person(s), [[1-peter 3 5|1Pe.3:5;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[titus 2 10|Tit.2:10.]]† (AS)
κοσμικός, -ή, -όν (κόσμος) 1. pertaining to the world or universe. 2. of this world, earthly. [[hebrews 9 1|Heb.9:1.]] 3. In ethical sense, worldly: ἐπιθυμίαι, [[titus 2 12|Tit.2:12.]]† (AS)

κόσμιος, -ον (in cl. -α, -ον), (κόσμος), [in LXX: [[ecclesiastes 12 9|Ecc.12:9]] (תָּקַן)* ;] orderly, decent, modest: [[1-timothy 2 9|1Ti.2:9]] (WH, mg., -ίως, which see) [[1-timothy 3 2|1Ti.3:2.]]† (AS)

κοσμοκράτωρ, -ορος, ὁ (κόσμος, κρατέω), 1. in Orphic hymns, al. (see AR, Eph., l.with), a ruler of the whole world (and so in Rabbinic writings: קוֺזמוֺקְרָטוֺר). 2. a ruler of this world (in contrast to παντο κράτωρ): οἱ κ. τ. σκότους τούτου, the rulers of this dark world, [[ephesians 6 12|Eph.6:12.]]† (AS)

κόσμος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: [[genesis 2 1|Gen.2:1]], [[deuteronomy 4 19|Deu.4:19 17:3]], [[isaiah 24 21|Isa.24:21 40:26]] (צבא), [[exodus 33 5|Exo.33:5]], 6 [[jeremiah 2 32|Jer.2:32 4:30]], [[ezekiel 7 20|Eze.7:20 16:11 23:40]] (עֲדִי), [[isaiah 61 10|Isa.61:10]] (כְּלִי), al., Wis.2:24 and freq., Sir.6:30, al ;] 1. order (Hom., Plat., al.). 2. ornament, adornment, esp. of women (Hom., al.): [[1-peter 3 3|1Pe.3:3.]] 3. Later, the world or universe, as an ordered system (Plat., al.): [[acts 17 24|Act.17:24]], [[romans 4 13|Rom.4:13]], [[1-corinthians 3 22|1Co.3:22]], [[philippians 2 15|Php.2:15]], [[hebrews 4 3|Heb.4:3]], al. 4. In late writers only, the world, i.e. the earth (= ἡ οἰκουμένη, cf. [[matthew 4 8|Mat.4:8]] with [[luke 4 5|Luk.4:5]]): [[matthew 4 8|Mat.4:8]], Mrk.16:[15], [[colossians 2 20|Col.2:20]], [[1-timothy 6 7|1Ti.6:7]], al.; hence by meton., (a) of the human inhabitants of the world: [[matthew 5 14|Mat.5:14 15:38]], [[mark 14 9|Mrk.14:9]], [[john 1 10|Jhn.1:10 4:42 12:47]], [[romans 3 6|Rom.3:6]], [[1-corinthians 4 13|1Co.4:13]], [[2-corinthians 5 19|2Co.5:19]], [[2-peter 2 5|2Pe.2:5]], al.; (b) of worldly affairs or possessions: [[matthew 16 26|Mat.16:26]], [[mark 8 36|Mrk.8:36]], [[luke 9 25|Luk.9:25]], [[1-corinthians 7 31|1Co.7:31]], [[1-john 2 16|1Jn.2:16]], al.; (with) in ethical sense, of the ungodly: [[john 7 7|Jhn.7:7 14:17, 27]] [[1-corinthians 1 21|1Co.1:21]], [[james 1 27|Jas.1:27]], [[1-john 4 4|1Jn.4:4]], al.; (d) metaphorically: ὁ κ. τῆς ἀδικίας, [[james 3 6|Jas.3:6.]] SYN.: αἰών, which see (cf . also Dalman, Words, 162ff.; Tr., Syn., §lix; Westc., additional note on [[john 1 10|Jhn.1:10;]] DB, iv, 938ff.). (AS)
Κούαρτος, -ου, ὁ (Lat.), Quartus: [[romans 16 23|Rom.16:23.]]† (AS)
κούμ (Tr., txt., κοῦμ, Rec. κοῦμι) (Heb. imperat. masc., used as an interjection, קוּם), koum (arise): [[mark 5 41|Mrk.5:41.]]† (AS)
κουστωδία, -ας, ἡ (Lat. custodia), a guard: [[matthew 27 65|Mat.27:65-66 28:11]].† (AS)

κουφίζω (κοῦφος, light), [in LXX: [[exodus 18 22|Exo.18:22]], [[jonah 1 5|Jon.1.5]], al. (קָלַל hi.), [[esther 5 1|Est.5:1]], al. ;] 1. intrans., to be light (poetic chiefly). 2. to lighten, make light: with accusative, [[acts 27 38|Act.27:38.]]† (AS)

κόφινος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX: [[judges 6 19|Jdg.6:19]] (סַל), [[psalms 81 6|Psa.81:6]] (דּוּד)* ;] a basket, probably of wicker-work, such as were carried by Jews for food: [[matthew 14 20|Mat.14:20 16:9]], [[mark 6 43|Mrk.6:43 8:19 9:17 13:8]], [[john 6 13|Jhn.6:13]] (cf. σφυρίς).† (AS)

κράβαττος (Rec. κράββατος), ου, ὁ (a Macedonian word, = Lat. grabatus, cl. σκίμπους), [in Aquila.: [[amos 3 12|Amo.3:12]] * ;] a camp bed, pallet: [[mark 2 4|Mrk.2:4, 9 2:11-12 6:55]], [[john 5 8|Jhn.5:8-11]], [[acts 5 15|Act.5:15 9:33]] (see Swete, Mk., 24, and cf. κλίνη).† (AS)

κράζω [in LXX for זָעַק, צָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;] in cl. chiefly poët., 1. prop. onomatop., of the raven, to croak, hence generally, of inartic. cries, to scream, cry out (Æsch., al.): [[mark 5 5|Mrk.5:5 9:26 15:39]] (Rec., R, mg.), [[luke 9 39|Luk.9:39]], al.; of crying for vengeance (cf. [[genesis 4 10|Gen.4:10]]), [[james 5 4|Jas.5:4]]. 2. to cry, call out with a loud voice: with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 19 32|Act.19:32;]] before orat. dir., [[mark 10 48|Mrk.10:48]], [[luke 18 39|Luk.18:39]], al.; (ἐν) φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, [[mark 5 7|Mrk.5:7]], [[revelation 14 15|Rev.14:15]], al.; λέγων, [[matthew 8 29|Mat.8:29]], al.; of public teaching, [[john 1 15|Jhn.1:15]], [[romans 9 27|Rom.9:27]], al.; of importunate prayer (cf. [[job 35 12|Job.35:12]], [[psalms 3 5|Psa.3:5]], al.), [[romans 8 15|Rom.8:15]], [[galatians 4 6|Gal.4:6]]; pf. with Pres. sense (vernac.; M, Pr., 147), [[john 1 15|Jhn.1:15]] SYN.: see: βοάω (AS)

κραιπάλη (κρεπάλη, WH), -ης, ἡ (cf. κραιπαλάω for שִׁכּוֹר, [[isaiah 24 20|Isa.24:20 29:9]]) drunken nausea (EV, surfeiting): [[luke 21 34|Luk.21:34.]]† SYN.: κῶμος, revelling; μέθη, drunkeness; οἰνοφλυγία, a debauch; πότος, a drinking bout (see Tr., Syn., § lxi). (AS)

κρανίον, -ου, τό (κάρα, the head), [in LXX: [[judges 9 53|Jdg.9:53]], [[2-kings 9 35|4Ki.9:35]] (גֻּלְגֹּלֶת)* ;] a skull: [[matthew 27 33|Mat.27:33]], [[mark 15 22|Mrk.15:22]], [[luke 23 33|Luk.23:33]], [[john 19 17|Jhn.19:17]].† (AS)

κράσπεδον, -ου, τό [in LXX: [[numbers 15 38|Num.15:38-39]] (צִיצִת) [[deuteronomy 22 12|Deu.22:12]], [[zechariah 8 23|Zec.8:23]] (כָּנָף)* ;] 1. in cl., an edge, border. 2. In LXX (see supr.) and NT, a tassel or corner: [[matthew 9 20|Mat.9:20 14:36 23:5]], [[mark 6 56|Mrk.6:56]], [[luke 8 44|Luk.8:44]].† (AS)
